appearances.snippet: And on September 10th, 2025, not only was he serving in the House of Reps, but he was also serving as a Provo police officer, special victims unit. ... He's also on ICAC, Internet Crimes Against Children.

records.text: Citing a May 20th, 2025 Instagram post, Owens said Tyler Clancy received the LaGrand and Beth Baker Award for his work as a Provo special victims detective helping rescue children, dismantle human trafficking rings and bring predators to justice.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Check out this Instagram post from 2025. It reads, this was posted on May 20th, it reads, Rep Tyler Clancy doesn't just talk public safety, he lives it. ... Today he received the LaGrand and Beth Baker Award for his service as a detective in Provo PD's special victims unit where he helped. ... You guys got it. You know what I'm going to say. Rescue children, dismantle human trafficking rings and bring predators to justice.

records.text: Owens said other people confirmed Tyler Clancy was on duty as a Provo police officer on September 11th; she alleged he was at Timpanogos Hospital shortly after Charlie Kirk arrived.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Open to updating these facts if more information lands upon our desk. We also offered to have him on the show to speak about this. What we have confirmed through other people is that Tyler Clancy was in fact on duty as a Provo police officer on September 11th. He was allegedly at Timpanogos Hospital shortly after Charlie (Charlie Kirk) arrived. And then when Erika Kirk was due to land, it was time.

records.text: Owens said Governor Spencer Cox promoted Tyler Clancy shortly after the assassination, Clancy left his Provo SVU/ICAC detective role, and his appointment as the youngest state homeless coordinator was announced October 30th.
